University College of Applied Sciences (UCAS)

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
Technical College Gaza Operational

The University College of Applied Sciences (UCAS), established in 1998, is a private higher education institution in Gaza City specialising in applied and technical education. It offers two- and four-year programmes in information technology, applied sciences, and engineering technology, and has been recognised for its role in developing Gaza's technical workforce.
